Terms of Service

These terms are the agreement between you and ClockTime, Inc. for using ClockTime. They cover what you get, what we ask of you, and what happens when plans change or end.

Last updated: September 12, 2026

1. The agreement#

ClockTime is operated by ClockTime, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("we", "us"). By creating an account or using the service you accept these Terms and our Privacy Policy. If you accept on behalf of a company, you confirm you have authority to bind it. You must be at least 18, or the age of legal majority where you live.

2. The service#

ClockTime provides web analytics and related tools: a tracking script, dashboards for traffic and realtime activity, visitor journeys, funnels, goals, performance (Core Web Vitals), public share pages, embeddable widgets, APIs, optional revenue attribution integrations, digests and alerts, an in-dashboard AI assistant, and an MCP connector for authorized agents.

3. Your account#

  • Keep your sign-in methods secure. Activity through your account, API keys, passkeys, SSO, or connected apps is treated as yours.
  • Provide accurate account information and keep a reachable email for notices.
  • You are responsible for people you invite and the roles you assign, including organization workspaces.

4. Acceptable use#

You agree to all of the following:

  • Do not attempt to reverse engineer, decompile, or copy the tracking script or backend telemetry engine.
  • Do not transmit illegal material or distribute malware using our script endpoints.
  • Do not abuse API rate limits or deliberately cause denial of service to ClockTime edge collectors.
  • Do not collect personal identifiable data (PII) such as Social Security numbers, health records, or credit card numbers inside custom event metadata.

5. Your data and publication surfaces#

You retain full ownership of all telemetry, event stats, and revenue records collected from your sites. We never sell your data to third-party ad exchanges or data brokers.

When you enable public share links or embeddable metrics widgets, you understand that those chosen stats will be publicly viewable by anyone with the link.

6. API keys, agents, and AI features#

  • API tokens allow read and write access to your project datasets. Store them as environment secrets and revoke compromised tokens immediately.
  • When using our ZKTeco Biometric Terminals (MCP) server or AI assistant, your prompt data is processed strictly to generate analytics insights and is never used to train public machine learning models.

7. Fees, trials, and billing#

  • Free Trials: New workspaces receive a 14-day free trial with full access to standard features.
  • Paid Plans: Subscriptions are billed in advance on a monthly or annual cadence.
  • Usage & Overage: If your monthly event volume exceeds your plan quota, we will notify you and provide graceful upgrade options without abruptly dropping tracking data.

8. Cancelling and deleting#

You can cancel your subscription at any time directly from the billing settings. Your access continues until the end of the current billing cycle. You may request permanent workspace data deletion at any time.

9. Suspension and termination by us#

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate our Acceptable Use policy, fail to pay invoices after repeated notifications, or pose security risks to our platform infrastructure.

10. Changes to the service#

We continually improve ClockTime by releasing new features, performance optimizations, and API updates. We will provide advance notice for any breaking changes to public APIs.

11. Intellectual property#

ClockTime, Inc. owns all intellectual property rights in the ClockTime platform, logos, software, and brand assets. You may not use our trademarks without prior written permission.

12. Disclaimers#

The service is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement.

13. Limitation of liability#

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, ClockTime, Inc. shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages resulting from your use of the service.

14. Indemnification#

You agree to indemnify and hold harmless ClockTime, Inc. and its officers, directors, and employees against any third-party claims arising from your breach of these terms or misuse of the platform.

15. Governing law and disputes#

These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to conflict of law principles. Any legal proceedings shall be conducted in state or federal courts located in Delaware.

16. Changes to these terms#

We may update these terms periodically. When we make material changes, we will notify you via email or prominent dashboard banner at least 14 days before they take effect.
